speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for sharing that. To better understand your condition, can you tell me how long you have been experiencing the cough and shortness of breath, and does it worsen at night or with physical activity?

speaker: Patient
text: I've had the cough going on for about four weeks now, and the shortness of breath started more recently. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Asthma (Persistent cough and shortness of breath with exertion, confirmed by prior medical history).
